color.note: Walnut & Ember. Four themes: dark is the default, light is paper, sepia is night reading, contrast is the high-contrast accessibility theme (7:1 text). Ember is the brand voice in the chrome; inside the player the accent comes from the current cover (cover-accent).

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. Walnut-black in dark, paper in light.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the Continue listening hero, inputs at rest.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Things that float or are selected: the mini-player, active segment, secondary button fill.

tokens.name: raised-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for raised and quiet controls.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and card borders. Decorative only; never the only thing that marks a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, toggles off, outline buttons). At least 3:1 on ground and surface in every theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on ground, surface and raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: authors, narrators, labels under controls. 6:1 or better on ground, surface and raised in every theme.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary metadata only (dates fetched, file sizes), 13px and up. At least 4.5:1 on ground, surface and raised.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ember as text and icons: links, active tab, focus, overlines. 4.5:1 on ground, surface and raised in every theme.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Ember as a fill: primary buttons, the app icon, progress outside the player. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: accent-fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill and its hover and pressed fills (at least 4.9:1 in every theme).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected filter chips, the read-along sentence wash, quiet-button hover. Never under small accent text.

tokens.name: cover-accent
tokens.usage: Inside the player only: overwritten at runtime with a muted accent sampled from the current cover (set --cover-accent on the player root). Falls back to ember. The sampler keeps it light enough that on-cover-accent reads at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: cover-tint
tokens.usage: Inside the player only: the cover's dominant color, used at 30–70% in the player background fade. Overwritten at runtime; falls back to surface.

tokens.name: on-cover-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on cover-accent (the play button). Dark themes sample a light accent with charcoal on it; light and sepia sample a deep accent with white on it.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Downloaded, scan finished, saved. A teal, off the red–green axis; always with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Files still copying, metadata conflicts. Always with the alert icon and a plain sentence.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Revoke access, delete, failed scans. A rose, kept clear of ember; always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: brand-walnut
tokens.usage: The shelf plank under spines, onboarding and the first-scan celebration. Material color, not UI.

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: Page edges behind covers in the player and book detail. Material color, not UI.

tokens.name: lab-ground
tokens.usage: Research lab only: page background. The lab ignores the reading themes.

tokens.name: lab-surface
tokens.usage: Research lab only: panels and tables.

tokens.name: lab-line
tokens.usage: Research lab only: rules and grid lines.

tokens.name: lab-ink
tokens.usage: Research lab only: primary text on lab-ground and lab-surface.

tokens.name: lab-muted
tokens.usage: Research lab only: secondary text on lab-ground and lab-surface (7:1 or better).

tokens.name: lab-accent
tokens.usage: Research lab only: selection, waveform, clip handles. 8:1 on lab-ground.

tokens.name: lab-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Research lab only: body text in notes and the fair-practice line, on lab-ground and lab-surface (10:1).

tokens.name: lab-line-strong
tokens.usage: Research lab only: control borders, chapter marks and table header rules (3:1 on lab-ground).

tokens.name: lab-data
tokens.usage: Research lab only: the selected clip on the waveform and the coverage-matrix ramp (use at 25/50/75/100%). Validated with lab-moment for colour-vision separation; text on it is lab-ground.

tokens.name: lab-moment
tokens.usage: Research lab only: marked moments (flag + number, never colour alone). Text on it is lab-ground.

tokens.name: lab-wave
tokens.usage: Research lab only: waveform bars already played. Decorative.

tokens.name: lab-wave-dim
tokens.usage: Research lab only: waveform bars not yet played. Decorative.

tokens.name: read-ink
tokens.usage: Reader body text, and the current sentence in read-along.

tokens.name: read-rest
tokens.usage: Read-along with Brighten: every sentence except the current one. Still 4.5:1 or better on ground in every theme, so the page stays readable.

tokens.name: read-wash
tokens.usage: Read-along Wash: the soft ember band behind the sentence being spoken. Moves with the voice.

tokens.name: read-word
tokens.usage: Word emphasis: the 2px underline under the word being spoken, and the Underline highlight style.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Your own highlights, kept across listening and reading. Always paired with mark-edge, so it never relies on colour.

tokens.name: mark-edge
tokens.usage: The 2px underline under your own highlights, and the highlight swatch in lists.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection in the reader. Cool, so it never looks like a highlight or the read-along wash.

tokens.name: note-dot
tokens.usage: The small mark after a sentence that carries a note.

tokens.name: pill-voice
tokens.usage: The Back to the voice pill's fill. Text is ink with an ember icon; shadow-float lifts it.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home greeting, onboarding headlines. Tablet and desktop only at 40px; 32px on phone.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Book detail title, phone greeting, page titles.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Player title.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Book titles in the hero card and list headers.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headings on Home, Library and Book detail.

styles.name: chapter
styles.usage: Chapter names in the reader and on the paper tiles. Always italic.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Point Tendshelf at a folder of audiobooks and they appear here.
styles.usage: Descriptions, empty states, onboarding copy.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Imogen Hale · read by Theo Marsh
styles.usage: Default UI text and list rows.

styles.name: button-lg
styles.usage: Primary 56px buttons.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, segmented controls, tab labels on tablet and desktop.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata under titles.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: The smallest text in the product: labels under player controls, phone tab labels. Never smaller.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels in accent or ink-muted. One per block.

styles.name: time-display
styles.usage: The big elapsed-in-chapter time in the player. Tabular figures.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Scrubber labels, durations. Tabular figures.

styles.name: time-sm
styles.usage: Chapter durations in lists. Tabular figures.

styles.name: read-sm
styles.sample: She carried it up the hundred and nine steps with both hands.
styles.usage: Smallest reading size, also the phone default for dense books.

styles.name: read-md
styles.sample: She carried it up the hundred and nine steps with both hands.
styles.usage: Default reading size on every device.

styles.name: read-lg
styles.sample: She carried it up the hundred and nine steps with both hands.
styles.usage: Largest standard size. Large-text mode can go further; the column narrows to keep about 45 to 68 characters a line.

styles.name: read-focus
styles.sample: She carried it up the hundred and nine steps with both hands.
styles.usage: Focus line: the one sentence in view, centred.

spacing.note: 8px grid. 4, 12 and 20 are half steps for inside controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Label under icon, title-to-author gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between chips.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between list rows' text and their cover.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps between grid covers.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections on phone; tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between sections on tablet and desktop; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Page top on desktop, hero padding.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Empty-state breathing room.

radius.note: Books keep crisp corners; controls go soft; primary actions are pills.

tokens.name: radius-cover
tokens.usage: Every cover and spine. Books are crisp, never rounded cards.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tooltips, source badges, small thumbnails in compare rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, the mini-player, the player's settings bar, list cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, the top of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons, chips, segmented controls, avatars.

shadow.note: Shadows only where something floats or is a physical book.

tokens.name: shadow-cover
tokens.usage: Covers in hero and player positions.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Mini-player, toasts, the desktop player panel.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px ground gap, then 2px of solid ember (white in contrast). Follows the control's radius.

duration.note: Quick and calm: 150–250ms for UI, nothing bounces for long.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Pressed states, toggles.

tokens.name: duration-highlight
tokens.usage: Read-along sentence cross-fade.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, chip selection, tab changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Sheets, toasts, partial swaps (HTMX settle).

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Mini-player to full player, page transitions.

tokens.name: duration-ring
tokens.usage: Progress rings filling after a change.

tokens.name: duration-follow
tokens.usage: Reader auto-scroll that keeps the current sentence in the top third of the column.

tokens.name: duration-pill
tokens.usage: Back to the voice pill appearing after you scroll away from the voice.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: Default for anything moving within the screen.

tokens.name: easing-enter
tokens.usage: Sheets, toasts and panels arriving.

tokens.name: easing-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving.

tokens.name: easing-expand
tokens.usage: Shared-element cover from mini-player to full player. A single soft settle, no bounce.

tokens.name: size-tap
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for anything tappable.

tokens.name: size-tab-bar
tokens.usage: Phone bottom tab bar, including the home-indicator inset.

tokens.name: size-mini-player
tokens.usage: Mini-player height.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Tablet side rail width.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar width.

tokens.name: size-player-panel
tokens.usage: Desktop right-side player panel.

tokens.name: size-content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on desktop.

tokens.name: size-measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for reading text and descriptions.

tokens.name: size-read-measure
tokens.usage: Reader text column, at most. About 34em; narrows on phones to the screen minus 24px each side.

tokens.name: size-read-measure-min
tokens.usage: Reader column never narrower than this on tablet and desktop; below it, the type steps down a size.

tokens.name: size-pill
tokens.usage: Back to the voice pill height.

leading.note: Reader line-height choices, as multipliers of the reading size.

tokens.name: leading-compact
tokens.usage: Reading settings: Compact.

tokens.name: leading-normal
tokens.usage: Reading settings: Normal (default).

tokens.name: leading-airy
tokens.usage: Reading settings: Airy. Also the large-text default.
